apps.localizedDescription: Chance is an imageboard browser built with Flutter for iOS and Android, with features like multi-column layout, media gallery, saved threads, filters, and archive support.

versions.localizedDescription:
**You will not be able to downgrade from this version due to changes in the saved database format. Please backup before upgrading if you want to be able to downgrade**

---

## New Features

- iPhone Duo interface
  - Sidebar aligned with iOS standard
  - Status bar handling
  - New compact sidebar layout for different functions
  - Swipe left/right at bottom of screen to switch tabs even with sidebar layout
- AyaseQuart archive support
- Rewrite of tree comment tracking
  - For "new posts inserted at bottom" mode (default)
  - Goal is that posts are never inserted into existing/scrolled-past trees
  - Add the parent as a dimmed context in the inserted subtrees
- Customizable filter highlight color
  - Matched text is highlighted specifically
- Text highlighting combines across multiple sources

## General Improvements

- Added video gestures and controls to soundposts
- Better handling of Reddit login firewall
  - Added alternative API to /morechildren
- Added haptic feedback in a lot of places
- Tweaks to the luck algorithm
- Show usernames as Reddit quotelinks instead of identifiers (not relevant)
- Long-press "#" button in search page to open a board/thread/comment by URL
- Use alternative FoolFuuka search page to bypass server-side block
- Rewrite archive handling
  - Goal is that thread doesn't get stuck in archived mode
- Optimized new tab board picker
  - If closed without picking a board, the new tab will be closed too
  - Appears instantly without flash of empty catalog
- Added a long-press menu to cross-thread quotelinks
- Drag to reorder saved threads in drawer (when sorting by order added)

## Tweaks

- Board switcher optimizations
- Smarter selection of next tab after closing a tab
- Format boards according to site in error messages
- Optimized xenforo-based forum loading performance
- Hero animation from rich link thumbnails
- "hn" shortcut for Hacker News in board switcher
- Optimized shorter thread indicator menu error messages
- Don't insert (OP) quotelink on top level Reddit comments
- Try to preserve Reddit title when thread is deleted
- Rewrote search query pagination interface
- Centered active thread in catalog instead of aligning to bottom
- New style for selected threads to match tabs
- Better support for cyclic/infinite threads on dvach and 8chan
- Highlight currently selected board in board switcher

## Bugfixes

- Scrolling to top when tapping buttons at top of screen (iPad, iPhone Duo)
- Timeout when trying to register with Firebase notifications
- Gray screen flash in captcha popup
- False-positive compatibility error due to cached GREASE TLS algorithms
- Broken videos when swiping quickly on Reddit
- Some boards on 8chan tried to post 5 images per post instead of 3
- Potential fixes for "App not responding" on Android
- (Dead) seen in quotelinks in search results
- (OP) not seen in quotelink search results
- Try to avoid stale site data when files per post changes
- Newly discovered pages were not marked as unread
- Missing handling for loading a forum post from an unloaded page
- Attachment preloading errors popped up for background threads
- Reloading threads could get stuck if switching tab during load
- Post scroll position was not optimal when loading an earlier forum page
- Poor handling of non-existent subreddits
- Cancelling one http/2 request could break the others on the same connection
- Reddit crossposts with quotes had broken OPs
- Cloudflare could popup from reply box image suggestion requests
- Edited posts not properly recognized as changed
- Reddit threads could be come corrupted on boards with very high identifier values
- Error loading reddit children could cause an improper alert popup
- Replies count/button not shown in split tree scenario
- Transient message popups had no height cap
- Thread auto-update would try to extend deep comment chains
  - Since this is now heavily restricted by Reddit, just refresh the thread root
- new/unseen label always shown on unloaded comments on Reddit
- Post highlighting transitioned at end of refresh instead of at beginning
- Comment loading errors were not dismissible by tapping in the background
- Posting on holotower gave an error message since PHP update
- gelbooru image urls could not be loaded due to their hotlink protection
- Reddit username /u/ prefix handling was not consistent
- Non-favourited subreddits would disappear after 3 days
- Many search query fields would not enable the search button when changing them
- OP post always grew in height on load when discovering how many replies it had
- Long search filters got cut off in the search history
- Thread had to reload when switching between one/two pane layout
- Rich links could get cut off when width was limited
- QUIC and HTTP/3 crash fixes
- Poor handling of some weird dvach sticky threads
- Precaching attempted to download deleted files
- Reordering watched threads from drawer broke in reverse-sort order
